page.overview:
What is Kalisk?

The Kalisk, classified as Specimen XX0522 by Weyland-Yutani Corporation, was a gigantic creature native to the planet Genna. It was said to be the definitive apex predator.

A female Kalisk was hunted by the Dek to prove himself to his clan. At the same time, she was hunted by synthetics of the Weyland-Yutani Corporation. Her pup, nicknamed Bud, was accidentally adopted by Dek and the synthetic Thia and later befriended when Bud was returned to her, Dek instead choosing to claim the skull of Weyland-Yutani combat synthetic Tessa for his coming-of-age hunt and to show up his father when Tessa killed her to escape from her stomach.
